subject.title: Add gated Claw discovery and API projection

question: Should ClawHub adopt the experimental `claw` package family and expose it through the existing public package APIs while the governing RFC is still under review?
rationale: This creates a new registry family, public schema and API contract, deployment setting, dependency surface, and authoring model; automated correctness checks cannot establish whether that permanent product direction is accepted.

options.title: Sponsor the gated stack
options.body: Approve the experimental package and API direction, then review and land the four dependent slices together before enabling any deployment.

options.title: Defer public discovery
options.body: Continue the RFC and schema discussion but hold this API projection until the long-term compatibility contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated stack
recommendation.body: Approve the experimental package and API direction, then review and land the four dependent slices together before enabling any deployment.

likelyOwner.reason: The RFC history connects this reviewer most directly to the Claw product model and unresolved sponsorship decision.
